race.comment: Siding with the unraced PARCAE (9), a filly by Blue Point who debuts for the Freedman yard. She's out a handy mare Deity who raced for Godolphin and she's won a few jumpouts as well as a trial in Sydney earlier this year. Looks ready to go and it's no surprise the market likes her early. ARMORWARE (6) is a colt by Armory on debut for the Laurie yard. He's won a jumpout leading in and looks handy, respecting. GALINDO (3) resumes. She was in the market on debut at Pakenham but didn't fire - look for an improved run this time in. GOLDEN CICADA (8) was just fair on debut at Pakenham Synthetic over this trip but can improve with that run under the belt.
